rationale: All deterministic checks pass. Export validates status before touching the destination, prevents overwriting task storage, filters and numerically sorts tasks, writes UTF-8 JSON arrays including the empty case, creates parent directories, atomically replaces destinations, preserves storage, and returns stable text or JSON summaries. The atomic helper has clear temporary-file cleanup, and the focused tests cover ordering, filtering, UTF-8, replacement, invalid inputs, storage preservation, banner behavior, and help. The banner meets the exact asset contract and uses EXPORT-related record labels, but it resembles twelve unrelated metadata lines more than a coherent banner or export symbol. There is little visual hierarchy, framing, or deliberate negative space, so ordinary-terminal recognizability and composition are limited despite full mechanical compliance. The diff remains focused and clean.
